race.comment: EXTINGUISH (6) has just missed in her two runs back but is at her top now and is unbeaten at this trip. Drawn sticky but Pannell can overcome. FAST TEMPO (7) finished strong to score well here two weeks ago over a shorter trip. The rise shouldn't bother and he should be further improved fourth-up. Big threat. MAXILDO (8) has returned in career-best order this prep and is yet to turn in a bad run. Is drawn to get all the favours and be right there when they quicken. FLAMING NAVY (3) showed his trademark early speed fresh but tired late. Fitter now and is sure to give plenty of cheek again. Could steal it if left alone. NICISH (1) has her first look at this trip but her splits throughout her career suggest she will relish the rise. Watch for her bursting through late. BIG SUE (2) came through a hot race fresh before getting the job done here two weeks ago. Has form at this trip and is a third-up winner. Have to include.
